title: CEL Conditions and Precedence for Reservation Assignments
summary: BigQuery is introducing logic-based reservation assignments using Common Expression Language (CEL) and a new precedence system to resolve matching conflicts.
details: The Assignment resource now includes a 'condition' field, which accepts a Common Expression Language (CEL) expression to define matching criteria for jobs. To handle scenarios where multiple assignments might match a single job, a new 'precedence' field (int64) has been added; higher values take priority. Additionally, the ReservationGroup schema now includes 'creationTime' and 'updateTime' output-only fields for better resource auditing.
